how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-dire-maul-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

E4.en: Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

rows.quest:8967:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ the ⟦E2⟧ to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. ⟦E3⟧ inside Blackrock Mountain with the ⟦E4⟧ and the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8967:details:0: It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire ⟦E5⟧. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.
rows.quest:8967:details:1: She didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
rows.quest:8967:progress:0: Surely you haven't already dealt with the ⟦E6⟧ of Isalien's spirit and the retrieval of the left piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, ⟦1⟧?
rows.quest:8967:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦2⟧, for putting Isalien's spirit to rest. Now, perhaps, she will find peace with her goddess. But, there is still a great deal of work ahead of us if we are to get out of this fine pickle we find ourselves in.
rows.quest:8967:completion:1: Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not ⟦E7⟧; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.
rows.quest:8990:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ the ⟦E2⟧ to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. ⟦E3⟧ inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined ⟦E8⟧ and the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8990:details:0: It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire ⟦E5⟧. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.
rows.quest:8990:details:1: She didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
rows.quest:8990:progress:0: Surely you haven't already dealt with the ⟦E6⟧ of Isalien's spirit and the retrieval of the right piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, ⟦3⟧? Be sure to recombine the pieces of the amulet before handing it to me.
rows.quest:8990:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦4⟧, for putting Isalien's spirit to rest. Now, perhaps, she will find peace with her goddess. And, we have the reassembled amulet, as well! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.
rows.quest:8990:completion:1: In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.
